query:
SELECT p.ticket_enabled,
            EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM rb_team_puzzle tp
                WHERE tp.puzzle_id = p.id AND tp.team_id = $1
                    AND tp.ctime_at <= NOW() - (p.ticket_cooldown * INTERVAL '1 second')
            ) AS cooldown_ready
        FROM rb_puzzle p
        WHERE p.id = $2;
